caveats: Sea cells = 3308 of 3600 region cells with finite SST on all 92 target days; 292 land cells set to 0. Threshold pools used baseline 1992-2002 dates plus the 5-day window extension days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05; each pool has 121 dates. Thresholds = 90th percentile (numpy method='hazen', Hyndman-Fan type 5) of the pool; day-60 values set to mean of days 59 and 61; both then smoothed with a centred 31-day wrap-around moving mean; all computed in float64. Two regional events detected.
